title: ITS: Update Collective Perception Service (CPS) to ETSI TR 103 562 V2.1.1

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 1c085dbd - 1 commit from branch release-4.2
  • 05ef0349 - ITS: Update Collective Perception Service (CPS) to ETSI TR 103 562 V2.1.1
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12366/diffs?diff_id=803699843&start_sha=393c723ca71de42d2b5bcfc516994aa5d65081da)

Hi @AndersBroman , I have not used Wireshark with C-ITS messages for few weeks and today I have found that CAM decoding is broken with this change.
This change combines older CAM.asn with newer ETSI-ITS-CCD.asn. But newer CAM definition is here https://forge.etsi.org/rep/ITS/asn1/cam_ts103900/-/blob/release2/CAM-PDU-Descriptions.asn.

Problematic is the field BasicVehicleContainerLowFrequency.pathHistory together with renaming type PathHistory in the ITS-Container.asn to type Path in the ETSI-ITS-CCD.asn and introducing another PathHistory in the ETSI-ITS-CCD.asn.

Could you fix it or shall I look at it?

Hi,
If you can fix it it would be great. I think you have more insight into the
standards than I have. I foolishly thought it would be backwards
compatible.
Best regards
Anders
